method: Paired wall-clock timings on the same 300 decoded source frames; frame decode excluded.

before.operation: Convert and resize both previous and current BGR frames on each call.

cached_previous_thumbnail.operation: Convert and resize current frame once, reusing its 64x64 grayscale thumbnail on the next call.

limitations: This isolates motion-score preprocessing. It is not a full model or end-to-end latency measurement.
